hypothesis: Within one era/config and a graph-depth cap of 6, at equal completed-evaluation budgets and matched runs, a policy prioritizing the least-covered publicly observable rotation-subfamily × loaded-feature cells will find more distinct cells containing locally qualifying graphs than random_weighted, without lowering lifetime_yield_rate beyond a preregistered non-inferiority margin. If cell attribution is not observable, leave cell-level coverage unknown rather than infer it; this hypothesis concerns in-sample coverage, not out-of-sample usefulness.
